The system uses these sets to define a lower-confidence decision rule that defers ambiguous cases to human review. This directly maps to GSE’s need for explainable, auditable decision-making where auto-picks are subject to confidence thresholds before publication. The audit log system ensures full traceability of each decision, supporting retroactive analysis and compliance. The disparity monitor extends this by detecting unfairness or model degradation, which translates into GSE’s model-drift detection and retraining protocols.
